english.title: Owner/Master of ship with electrical or electronic equipment affecting navigational systems or equipment
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) were the

(A)_[master]_
(B)_[owner]_

of a ship, namely **(..SPECIFY NAME OF SHIP..), which did not comply with

(C)_[paragraph 2]_
(D)_[paragraph 3]_

of regulation 17 of Chapter V in the Annex to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974 relating to electromagnetic capability in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 5(2)(f) and 10(1)(a) and (4) of the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being the owner / master of a ship
to which the Merchant Shipping (Safety of Navigation) Regulations 2020 applied
proceed / attempt to proceed
on a voyage / excursion
without complying with a
requirement in para 2 AND 3 of regulation 17
of Chapter V in the Annex
to the International Convention for the Safety of Life at Sea 1974
relating to the function of navigational systems AND equipment

Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine.
Indictment: A fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
